title: Verdict
description: PRAMANA on-chain verdict payload (spec §2.1 + §5). Version 0.1.0-draft. Produced by the ML layer; consumed by the chain CLI for EAS attestation.

specVersion.description: Spec version that produced this verdict.

evidenceHash.description: SHA-256 hex of canonical evidence.json (sorted keys, UTF-8, no whitespace). No 0x prefix.

onChain.description: Fields that map 1-to-1 to the EAS Verdict schema (spec §2.1).

sha256Hash.description: SHA-256 hex of raw media file bytes. No 0x prefix.

pHash.description: Perceptual hash uint64, hex string, no 0x prefix. Computed per spec §4.

wmId.description: TrustMark watermark ID uint64 hex string. '0' if no watermark decoded.

modelHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical model bundle (ONNX + head + config). No 0x prefix.

preprocHash.description: SHA-256 of preprocessing config + pinned library versions. No 0x prefix.

evidenceHash.description: Must equal top-level evidenceHash. Redundant but required by EAS schema.

expirationTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when this verdict expires. Must be > now and <= now + MAX_TTL. v1 default: now + 180 days.

refUID.description: EAS UID of the previous Verdict being superseded, if any. Omit or set to '0x0000...0000' if not superseding.
